A: A bruised purple sky bleeds into the still water, where the masts of sleeping yachts stand like silent sentinels against the first pale sliver of sun.
The first pale sliver of sun sliced through the mist, igniting the wet hulls of the moored sloops into streaks of molten gold against the bruised purple water.
Gilded mist clung to the blackened hulls of idle barges as the first slant of sunlight shattered the mirror-still water into a thousand trembling shards of amber and rose.

Fog clung to the water like a damp wool blanket, softening the silhouettes of the moored trawlers until only the rhythmic creak of the pilings and the first pale sliver of sun breaking through the mist remained.
Crimson light spills across the still water, igniting the masts of the anchored boats like a field of burning torches.
B: A bruised purple sky bleeds into the steel-grey water, where the masts of silent fishing boats sway gently against the first trembling light of day.
Amber light spills across the rippling water, catching the gulls' cries and the creak of mooring lines as the fishing boats begin their slow, rhythmic sway against the grey mist.
Gilded fingers of sunrise stretched across the still, mirror-like water, catching the rusted hulls of sleeping fishing boats and turning the fog into a soft, breathing amber haze.
Fog clung to the water like a damp woolen shawl while the first pale gold of sunrise bled through the mist, turning the black silhouettes of the moored yachts into shimmering embers.
Copper light fractured across the oil-slicked water, igniting the mist that clung to the rusted masts of the sleeping fishing fleet.
